outline.title: Ada's Tub Sub
outline.logline: Ada wants to find out how a submarine sinks and rises, so she turns her bathtub into an ocean lab and discovers the answer herself.
outline.theme: figuring things out by trying an experiment

characters.name: Ada
characters.description: A six-year-old who loves submarines and oceans and wants to know exactly how they sink and rise.

beats.title: Ada and her toy sub
beats.summary: Ada floats her toy submarine in a bucket of water and watches it bob, wishing she knew how real subs move up and down in the deep ocean.

beats.title: The question appears
beats.summary: Ada decides she must solve the sinking-and-rising mystery right now and wonders where she can test ideas without needing a real ocean.

beats.title: The first try fails
beats.summary: She pushes the toy under water with her hand, but it just pops up again and she cannot make it stay down or come up on its own.

beats.title: Bathtub plan
beats.summary: Ada carries her toy to the big bathtub, fills it with water, and decides to run a real experiment there instead of guessing.

beats.title: The tub experiment
beats.summary: Ada fills a small bottle with water, seals it inside a zip bag for ballast, and watches the toy sub sink when the bag is full and rise when she lets air in.

beats.title: Ada knows
beats.summary: Ada smiles as the toy moves exactly as she planned and feels the answer settle in her mind without anyone else telling her.

pages.text: Ada set the little submarine on the water in the bucket. It rocked gently on top and stayed there. How could a real one ever go down deep and then come back?
She leaned closer. Then she stood tall. There had to be a place to test what a submarine really does.
She pressed it under with one finger. The moment she stopped, it shot right back up again. Nothing stayed where she wanted it.
The bucket could not hold a proper test. Ada lifted the submarine and walked toward the bathroom door, sure the tub would serve as her ocean tank.
Water splashed into the big tub. Ada placed the submarine on the rim and thought about what could make it sink on purpose and rise again.
She filled a small bottle, sealed it tight in a bag, and clipped the bag to the submarine. That extra weight might pull it where she needed.
Down went the submarine with the full bag! When air reached the bag it bobbed straight up again and Ada cheered at the sight.
Ada watched the submarine move exactly as she had planned inside the tub. Her eyes widened at the rise and fall she had made happen.
